summary: ansible.builtin.pip examples: install a package, a pinned version or version specifiers, several packages, through a proxy with environment, from svn+/git+ URLs or a local tarball, into a virtualenv (optionally with site packages or a specific virtualenv_command), and with extra_args --user.
questions: How do I install a Python package with Ansible?
How do I install a pip package into a virtualenv with Ansible?
How do I pin a pip package version in Ansible?
How do I use pip through a proxy in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Install Python packages with pip
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.pip:
    name: bottle==0.11
- ansible.builtin.pip:
    name:
      - django>1.11.0,<1.12.0
      - bottle>0.10,<0.20,!=0.11
- ansible.builtin.pip:
    name: bottle
    virtualenv: /my_app/venv
    virtualenv_command: virtualenv-3.13
- ansible.builtin.pip:
    name: six
  environment:
    https_proxy: 'https://127.0.0.1:8080'
```
